settings.heading: Merchant content sections
settings.text: A reusable page template that demonstrates the content blocks most stores need: FAQs, shipping, returns, sizing, care, warranty, contact, editorial proof, and journal entries.

settings.heading: What merchants usually need
settings.text: Use this page as a section library or duplicate the sections into policy, FAQ, support, and product education pages.

settings.title: Pre-purchase clarity
settings.text: FAQ, size guide, materials, product care, compatibility, and comparison content reduce support load before checkout.

settings.title: Post-purchase support
settings.text: Shipping, returns, warranty, repair, account, and contact sections make the store feel reliable after the order.

settings.title: Trust and proof
settings.text: Reviews, press quotes, field notes, certification claims, and process content help a brand justify premium pricing.

settings.title: Retention
settings.text: Newsletter, journal, drop access, and community links give shoppers a reason to return without fake urgency.

settings.heading: How should I choose my size?
settings.content: Start with your usual size and check the garment measurements. If you plan to layer, size up only when the chest or shoulder measurement is tight.

settings.heading: When will my order ship?
settings.content: Most orders ship within 1-2 business days. Delivery timing depends on destination and service selected at checkout.

settings.heading: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.content: Unworn items can be returned within the stated return window. Keep original packaging and start the return from the support page.

settings.heading: How do I care for technical fabrics?
settings.content: Wash cold, avoid fabric softener, and hang dry. For waterproof shells, reproof the face fabric when water stops beading.

settings.heading: Domestic shipping
settings.content: Explain carrier options, processing time, free-shipping threshold, tracking, and delivery windows.

settings.heading: International shipping
settings.content: Clarify duties, taxes, customs delays, unsupported regions, and final-sale restrictions by market.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: State the return window, item condition, return shipping responsibility, refund timing, and how customers start a return.

settings.heading: Exchanges
settings.content: Explain whether exchanges are instant, inventory-dependent, or handled as a return plus a new order.

settings.heading: Teach the product, not just the policy
settings.text: Use image-with-text for size guides, material proof, repair programs, fit notes, ingredient lists, certification explanations, or product education.

settings.heading: Set expectations clearly
settings.text: Use this block for warranty coverage, repair terms, final-sale rules, subscription policy, preorder timing, or wholesale terms. Keep language specific and avoid vague trust claims.

settings.heading: Contact the team
settings.details: Use the contact form for sizing help, warranty claims, order questions, wholesale requests, or custom project leads.

settings.heading: Keep shoppers in the loop
settings.text: Use newsletter blocks on support and education pages when a shopper is engaged but not ready to buy.
